stem: Which is the longest river of peninsular India, also called the "Dakshin Ganga"?
problem: Wording only: NCERT calls the Godavari the largest Peninsular river system (1,465 km) and does not use the word longest. The answer Godavari is not contradicted, but the stem is not literally supported by NCERT; consider 'largest river system'.
quote: The Godavari is the largest Peninsular river system. It is also called the Dakshin Ganga.
